First, convert 48 weeks and 5 days into days:  
48 weeks = 48 × 7 = 336 days  
Add 5 days → 341 days total to subtract.

Start date: 1183-09-05 (assuming DD-MM-YYYY format given in question, so 5th September 1183).  
Subtract 341 days:  
September 5 → go back to previous year if needed.

From 1183-09-05:  
Back 5 days → 1183-08-31.  
Back 336 more days (341 total):  
From 1183-08-31, subtract 1 year (1182-08-31) but 1182 is a common year (365 days).  
336 − 365 = −29 → means we went too far back by 365 days, so adjust forward 29 days from 1182-08-31:  
1182-09-29.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1182-09-29
